_comment: Local-dev defaults. Override in appsettings.{Environment}.json (e.g. appsettings.Production.json) or via environment variables for any non-local deployment. There are no secrets here — the SQL connection uses Active Directory Default auth (`az login`), and DevAuth.Enabled=true is fail-closed at startup outside the Development environment (see Program.cs).
_anthropic_comment: Ask AI Reports chat. No key is committed — set it locally with `dotnet user-secrets set "Anthropic:ApiKey" "sk-ant-..."` or the Anthropic__ApiKey env var. With no key the /api/ask endpoint returns 503 (chat_not_configured) and the rest of the app works normally. Switch Model to claude-sonnet-4-6 or claude-haiku-4-5 to trade quality for cost.
